provider_organization: Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB), Government of Türkiye

stipend.notes: Bachelor's TRY 6,500, master's TRY 9,500, PhD TRY 13,000 a month (current rates on the official site)

additional_benefits: Flight ticket at the start and end of studies

application_fee.notes: Applications are online and free of charge.

eligibility_criteria.min_gpa: Bachelor's applicants at least 70%; master's and PhD at least 75%; medicine, dentistry and pharmacy at least 90%
eligibility_criteria.age_limit: Bachelor's under 21; master's under 30; PhD under 35

preparation_alerts: Bring all certificates of your latest completed education to the interview

criteria.criterion: Preliminary check of minimum grades and other basic criteria

criteria.notes: Bachelor's applicants only: 30 questions in maths, geometry and logic
15 to 30 minutes with academics and experts

criteria.criterion: Final assessment by the selection committee

source_urls.title: Türkiye Scholarships: application calendar
source_urls.used_for: General application period 10 Jan to 20 Feb, interviews April to June, results early August

verification_status.verification_notes: The official calendar gives the general application period as 10 January to 20 February without naming a year, so the 2027 call is marked likely for Jan 2027 but dates are left null until it is announced. The full document list is not on the pages checked (it is shown in the application portal); required_documents is empty for that reason. No Nigeria-specific rules found. 'All' nationalities is based on the programme being an international call with no country list on the pages checked; a human should confirm any nationality exclusions.
